scope: Critical literature comparison of self-produced 21 functional tRNAs and self-encoded DNA replication against simultaneous ribosome/template renewal; research-only

sources.citation: Li F, Baranwal AK, Maerkl SJ. Continuous in situ synthesis of a complete set of tRNAs sustains steady-state translation in a recombinant cell-free system. Nature Communications 16:6212 (2025).
sources.evidence_grade: E2 original main methods/results/controls/discussion/rights; no supplemental raw-trace reproduction
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0 publisher original; third-party assets separate; paraphrase only
positive_outcomes: 21 functional tRNAs from linear DNA or nicked plasmid
Sustained up-to-20-hour steady-state sfGFP expression in microfluidic chemostat
At 0.4 nM reporter template, 100/150 nM tRNA linear-template input yielded about 10.5/17 micrograms per mL steady-state sfGFP; max nicked plasmid 13.6 micrograms per mL at 2.86 nM
negative_results: 4 nM reporter DNA initially active but sfGFP synthesis decayed to zero in continuous trials
2x NTP supply destroyed activity; 1.25x slight rescue with no steady-state
0.71 nM nicked plasmid did not sustain stable reporter synthesis
Un-nicked plasmid tRNA lower activity, precursor RNA contamination, competing transcription demands
external_support: Fresh protein/ribosome mix plus DNA/energy mix (3:2 feed ratio)
Externally supplied functional native ribosomes, translation factors and DNA templates
Prepared plasmid nicking/processing tools, reporter and microfluidic hardware
sources.replicate_unit: n=2 reactors/rings in key Fig4 chemostat readouts; not distinct offspring founders
sources.distinct_limit: Sustained replenished partial tRNA production does not show internal ribosome replacement or copied tRNA gene inheritance

sources.citation: Miyachi R, Masuda K, Shimizu Y, Ichihashi N. Simultaneous in vitro expression of minimal 21 transfer RNAs by tRNA array method. Nature Communications 16:7418 (2025).
sources.evidence_grade: E2 original main Methods/Results/Discussion and licensing; raw sequencing/proteomic/supporting data not reanalyzed
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; no reproduction/adaptation of third-party figures or article material
sources.program: University of Tokyo/Ichihashi and RIKEN/Shimizu (shares lineage with P44-S3 and Pass42)
positive_outcomes: Functional expression of all 21 tRNAs from one polycistronic DNA in tfPURE using tRNA arrays, RNase P, HDVR and T4 PNK
Translation of luciferase, sfGFP, GUS and codon reassignment validated by peptide identity
Approximately 3.7 micrograms/mL protein in array condition versus around 56 native tRNA in specified comparison
negative_results: Prepared ribosome and EF-Tu had residual endogenous tRNAs, needed repurification
One tRNA Pro 5-prime variant lacked activity; Asn and fMet had processing/background issues
Single 21-tRNA long operon much worse than staged short arrays on one DNA
Luciferase array translated product about 46% specific activity of native tRNA reference
Reporter-specific lower sfGFP/GUS active yield and unequal array positional output
external_support: Already-functional repurified native ribosomes and aminoacylation/translation machinery
Externally prepared T7 RNAP, RNase P, T4 PNK, DNA template and substrates
No demonstrated DNA-template self-copying linked to translation and daughter inheritance
sources.replicate_unit: Main reporter assays roughly n=3 independent biochemical reactions, not inherited cell genealogies
sources.distinct_limit: Functional minimal tRNA expression is not full translational machine self-renewal; unmodified tRNA affects fidelity/activity

sources.citation: Okauchi H, Ichihashi N. Continuous Cell-Free Replication and Evolution of Artificial Genomic DNA in a Compartmentalized Gene Expression System. ACS Synthetic Biology 10:3507-3517 (2021).
sources.evidence_grade: E2 ACS original main Methods/Results/controls/limitations; underlying sequencing/raw supporting files not independently analyzed
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 ACS original; critical paraphrase and bibliographic identifiers only
sources.program: University of Tokyo/Ichihashi (shared senior scientist/source lineage with P44-S2)
positive_outcomes: Circular genome encoding phi29 polymerase and Cre recombinase self-assisted DNA replication within prepared cell-free expression droplets
60 serial dilution transfers in each of two independently operated series from shared starting repertoire
Evolved round-30 DNA variant clone comparisons showed improved molecular replication fitness
Later transfer rounds maintained circular-DNA signal without further PCR rescue after earlier manual interventions
negative_results: Detection-floor PCR amplification and re-circularization rescue at rounds 9 and 18 (Exp1) and 15 (Exp2)
Failed full-length DNA amplification at round 60, possible shorter/parasitic templates unresolved
Alternative linear repetitive DNA 44 rounds with PCR rescues at 6,15,21,27 declined, little adaptive substitution signal
Two experiments share initial genome repertoire; PCR may itself contribute genetic mutations
external_support: Fresh complete cell-free protein expression machinery and nutrients introduced each transfer
Mechanical emulsification to fuse/divide droplets, 5x programmed dilution
PCR/ligation circularization rescue at selected rounds, externally prepared DNA/gene products
No tRNA or ribosome biogenesis module tied to DNA self-copying
sources.replicate_unit: Two independently run serial-dilution experiments using a common founding molecular genome; 60 rounds not 60 living lineage founder replicates
sources.distinct_limit: Demonstrated molecular gene-linked evolution, not autonomous whole translation apparatus/cell-lineage self-reproduction

cross_program_independence: EPFL Maerkl and Tokyo Ichihashi/RIKEN are two partly independent major programs. Tokyo 2025 and 2021 share Norikazu Ichihashi; Tokyo 2025 also overlaps 2025 aaRS study via Shimizu/Masuda. Different experiments/endpoints are not replications of complete closure.
unverified_combined_claim: No single examined original study demonstrated newly made replacement ribosomes plus continuously generated 21 tRNAs plus copied full templates plus unassisted daughters after withholding researcher-specific essential machinery and PCR rescue.
release_gate: Requires successful exact PR head CI and independently successful post-merge main push workflow; interactive writes do not prove scheduled-run GitHub write authority.
